firstCall.why: Medi-Cal is the gate to IHSS, and IHSS can pay the daughter for the hours she cut from work, the largest and fastest dollar value; apply for both at once.

families.notes: File the VA Survivors Pension (Intent to File) right after, via LA County MVA 877-452-8387. Medi-Cal excludes the A&A/medical-expense portion of a VA pension but may count basic pension; she should still stay under $1,836. If she pays her daughter under a written care agreement, that payment is a deductible medical expense for VA (raises the pension) but is income to the daughter. CalFresh/LIHEAP verdicts assume she shares food and utilities with the daughter's household.
